name: Mecsér (Hungary)
description: White field with a panel of red and white horizontal stripes at the hoist and a panel of green and white horizontal stripes at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Mecsér: a red shield with a white bird, with a black eagle crest, above a green scroll inscribed MECSÉR.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mecsér arms with crest and scroll
